findings.title: Unknown Threat Actor Uses AI-Driven ARTEX to Target South Korean Finance
findings.summary_md: CrowdStrike Intelligence published a disclosure on October 8, 2026 identifying open directories at a Hong Kong-based IP containing Claude Code session histories, Claude memory files, and ARTEX configuration files. The campaign was active from late September to early October 2026 and targeted South Korean financial organizations, with exfiltrated data from Shinhan Bank and other institutions. The researchers linked the activity to a Chinese-speaking actor who used DeepSeek v4.1-flash, GLM-5.3, and Grok 4.6 LLM backends.

findings.title: ARTEX AI Pentesting Tool Used in Data Theft Attacks on South Korean Financial Firms
findings.summary_md: The Hacker News reported on October 8, 2026 that researchers identified a targeted campaign against South Korean financial organizations using the open-source agentic penetration-testing suite ARTEX. The article notes CrowdStrike analysis of open directories exposing Claude session histories and ARTEX configs at a Hong Kong IP, and references overlapping targets including Shinhan Bank and Yegaram Savings Bank. A Telegram message from the suspected actor (@YY520CN) posted the same day denied responsibility.
